issue_context.title: Unifi integration default status is always "home" when controller is rebooted (while device is actually disconnected in Unifi Log )
issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/releases
  - Do not report issues for integrations if you are using custom components or integrations.
  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem

I noticed a bug in how Unifi integration manages device when controller is rebooted ( [original post here](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/device-tracker-reports-incorrect-state/230368?u=jokerigno) ) : status of devices tracked changes to unavailable -> home even for those devices that are disconnected. The status then stays "home" for more or less 5 min (I've checked many times) and then finally status is updated with the real one (not_home for example for away devices)

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Configuration -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.115.6
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 0.113 but I'm not sure at 100%
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): OS
- Integration causing this issue: Unifi
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifi/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->
Not applicable

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

No error in logs. Just a warning when controller is disconnected: 


```txt
Lost connection to UniFi controller
```

## Additional information

I've lately experienced this while being abroad HA would sometimes lose connection to the Unifi Controller and suddenly when reconnecting I was at home for a second and then away again. Triggering ton of automations.

Here's the logs explaining the issue.

### Home Assistant Logs of the Issue

As can be seen It disconnects for **15 seconds** from the controller.

```
2021-01-10 02:00:02 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.unifi] Lost connection to UniFi controller
2021-01-10 02:00:17 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.unifi] Will try to reconnect to UniFi controller
2021-01-10 02:00:17 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.unifi] Connected to UniFi controller
```

### Previous to the Disconnect

Using 3 entities to showcase the issue.

```
# Time of the state ... - 2:00:01
device_tracker.epson_printer            not_home
device_tracker.android_phone            not_home
device_tracker.javier_phone             home
```

### Integration Disconnects

Here it works well everything goes to unavailable

```
# Time of the state 2:00:02 - 2:00:17
device_tracker.epson_printer            unavailable
device_tracker.android_phone            unavailable
device_tracker.javier_phone             unavailable
```

### When it connects Again
Here comes the issues, It should show up exactly as before the disconnection, nothing happened on the network on those 15 seconds according to the unifi controller.

The first two devices suddenly show as home, for less than one second, and this is an issue since it triggers many automations right away.

```
# Time of the state 2:00:17
device_tracker.epson_printer            home
device_tracker.android_phone            home
device_tracker.javier_phone             home
```

And right after it reports the correct state.

```
# Time of the state 2:00:17 - ...
device_tracker.epson_printer            not_home
device_tracker.android_phone            not_home
device_tracker.javier_phone             home
```
This also might be causing https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/37330
Debug logs when this happen would help, you can share them with me through PM on discord or forums

Hello @Kane610 managed to manually trigger the bug. My Unifi Controller runs in a docker container behind a reverse proxy. I simply restarted (updated) the reverse proxy container really quick, making HA lose connection to the controller. Will send the logs to you on Discord.

But from what I'm seeing, this time just after reconnecting it set all the `not_home` devices to `home`, and 2 minutes (my default detection time) later they went back to `not_home`.

I will share with you the logs of Home Assistant, and the entities states in that period of time.
